```{r load-data}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(lme4)
library(clubSandwich)
library(knitr)
library(stargazer)

df               <- readRDS("analysis_data.rds")
experiment_master <- readRDS("experiment_master.rds")

df_prolific <- df %>% filter(!is.na(prolificPid))
df_organic  <- df %>% filter(is.na(prolificPid))
```

## Study Design

[Brief description of experiment — 3 arms (no_label, easy_label, hard_label), puzzle platform, Prolific + organic recruitment]

## Sample

```{r sample-summary}
df %>%
  distinct(userId, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(source = ifelse(!is.na(prolificPid), "Prolific", "Organic")) %>%
  count(source, treatment) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = n) %>%
  kable(caption = "Final Sample by Recruitment Source and Treatment Arm")
```

## Covariate Balance

```{r balance}
user_level <- experiment_master %>%
  distinct(userId, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(source = ifelse(!is.na(prolificPid), "Prolific", "Organic"))

# Continuous
continuous_vars <- c("age", "quantitativeExposure")
cont_means <- user_level %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarize(across(all_of(continuous_vars), ~ round(mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 2))) %>%
  pivot_longer(-treatment, names_to = "Covariate", values_to = "val") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = val)

cont_p <- map_dfr(continuous_vars, function(v) {
  p <- summary(aov(as.formula(paste(v, "~ treatment")), data = user_level))[[1]]["treatment", "Pr(>F)"]
  data.frame(Covariate = v, p_value = round(p, 4))
})
left_join(cont_means, cont_p, by = "Covariate") %>%
  kable(caption = "Continuous Covariate Balance (mean, ANOVA p)")

# Ordinal
ordinal_vars <- c("puzzleSkill", "puzzleEnjoyment", "energyLevel")
ord_medians <- user_level %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarize(across(all_of(ordinal_vars), ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  pivot_longer(-treatment, names_to = "Covariate", values_to = "val") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = val)

ord_p <- map_dfr(ordinal_vars, function(v) {
  p <- fisher.test(table(user_level$treatment, user_level[[v]]),
                   simulate.p.value = TRUE)$p.value
  data.frame(Covariate = v, p_value = round(p, 4))
})
left_join(ord_medians, ord_p, by = "Covariate") %>%
  kable(caption = "Ordinal Covariate Balance (median, Fisher's exact p)")

# Categorical
user_level %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarize(
    `% Prolific` = paste0(round(mean(source == "Prolific") * 100, 1), "%"),
    `% Desktop`  = paste0(round(mean(deviceType == "Desktop", na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%"),
    `% Female`   = paste0(round(mean(gender == "Female", na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%")
  ) %>%
  kable(caption = "Categorical Covariate Balance")

data.frame(
  Variable = c("source", "deviceType", "gender"),
  p_value  = c(
    round(fisher.test(table(user_level$treatment, user_level$source), simulate.p.value = TRUE)$p.value, 4),
    round(fisher.test(table(user_level$treatment, user_level$deviceType), simulate.p.value = TRUE)$p.value, 4),
    round(fisher.test(table(user_level$treatment, user_level$gender), simulate.p.value = TRUE)$p.value, 4)
  )
) %>%
  kable(caption = "Categorical Balance p-values (Fisher's exact)")
```

## Attrition

```{r attrition, results = 'asis'}
all_users <- experiment_master %>%
  distinct(userId, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    dropped   = as.integer(sessionComplete != TRUE),
    source    = ifelse(!is.na(prolificPid), "Prolific", "Organic"),
    treatment = relevel(factor(treatment), ref = "no_label")
  )

all_users %>%
  group_by(source, treatment) %>%
  summarize(
    n_started     = n(),
    n_dropped     = sum(dropped),
    attrition_pct = paste0(round(mean(dropped) * 100, 1), "%"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  kable(caption = "Attrition by Treatment Arm and Recruitment Source")

m_att_full     <- glm(dropped ~ treatment, data = all_users, family = binomial)
m_att_organic  <- glm(dropped ~ treatment, data = filter(all_users, source == "Organic"), family = binomial)
m_att_prolific <- glm(dropped ~ treatment, data = filter(all_users, source == "Prolific"), family = binomial)

stargazer(m_att_full, m_att_organic, m_att_prolific,
          type             = "html",
          column.labels    = c("Full", "Organic", "Prolific"),
          covariate.labels = c("Easy Label", "Hard Label"),
          dep.var.labels   = "Dropped Out",
          title            = "Table 1: Differential Attrition",
          digits           = 3,
          star.cutoffs     = c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001),
          report           = "vcs*p")
```

## Primary Results: log(Time Engaged)

```{r primary-model}
run_primary <- function(data) {
  m_lean    <- lmer(logTE ~ treatment + puzzleId + puzzleSkill + (1 | userId),
                    data = data, REML = FALSE)
  vcov_lean <- vcovCR(m_lean, cluster = data$userId, type = "CR1")
  rt_lean   <- coef_test(m_lean, vcov = vcov_lean, test = "Satterthwaite")

  m_full    <- lmer(logTE ~ treatment + puzzleId +
                      puzzleSkill + age + quantitativeExposure + energyLevel +
                      deviceType + tabSwitchTimePaused + (1 | userId),
                    data = data, REML = FALSE)
  vcov_full <- vcovCR(m_full, cluster = data$userId, type = "CR1")
  rt_full   <- coef_test(m_full, vcov = vcov_full, test = "Satterthwaite")

  trt_lean <- grepl("^treatment", rt_lean$Coef)
  trt_full <- grepl("^treatment", rt_full$Coef)

  bind_rows(
    data.frame(model = "Lean", term = rt_lean$Coef[trt_lean],
               est = round(rt_lean$beta[trt_lean], 3),
               se  = round(rt_lean$SE[trt_lean], 3),
               t   = round(rt_lean$tstat[trt_lean], 3),
               p   = round(rt_lean$p_Satt[trt_lean], 4)),
    data.frame(model = "Full", term = rt_full$Coef[trt_full],
               est = round(rt_full$beta[trt_full], 3),
               se  = round(rt_full$SE[trt_full], 3),
               t   = round(rt_full$tstat[trt_full], 3),
               p   = round(rt_full$p_Satt[trt_full], 4))
  )
}

bind_rows(
  run_primary(df)          %>% mutate(sample = "Full"),
  run_primary(df_prolific) %>% mutate(sample = "Prolific"),
  run_primary(df_organic)  %>% mutate(sample = "Organic")
) %>%
  select(sample, model, term, est, se, t, p) %>%
  arrange(term, model, sample) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = round(p.adjust(p, method = "BH"), 4)) %>%
  kable(caption = "Table 2: Primary Model — log(Time Engaged) by Sample (cluster-robust SEs, BH-adjusted)")
```

## Secondary: Zero-Attempt Skip Rate

```{r zero-att-skip}
run_zas <- function(data) {
  m <- glmer(
    zero_att_skip ~ treatment + puzzleId + scale(puzzleSkill) + (1 | userId),
    data = data, family = binomial,
    control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5))
  )
  cs   <- coef(summary(m))
  rows <- grep("^treatment", rownames(cs))
  data.frame(
    term = rownames(cs)[rows],
    OR   = round(exp(cs[rows, "Estimate"]), 3),
    z    = round(cs[rows, "z value"], 3),
    p    = round(cs[rows, "Pr(>|z|)"], 4)
  )
}

bind_rows(
  run_zas(df)          %>% mutate(sample = "Full"),
  run_zas(df_prolific) %>% mutate(sample = "Prolific"),
  run_zas(df_organic)  %>% mutate(sample = "Organic")
) %>%
  select(sample, term, OR, z, p) %>%
  arrange(term, sample) %>%
  kable(caption = "Table 3: Zero-Attempt Skip Model — OR by Sample (exploratory; raw p-values)")
```
